textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 9 science · Tissues in Action · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: A tissue is a group of similar cells that together perform a specific function.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: A tissue is a group of similar cells that together perform a specific function.
beats.speakEn: A tissue is a group of similar cells that together perform a specific function.

beats.en: Plants are fixed and need support, so their cells have walls and many tissues give strength. Animals move, so they need muscles and bones.
beats.speakEn: Plants are fixed and need support, so their cells have walls and many tissues give strength. Animals move, so they need muscles and bones.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 9 science · Tissues in Action · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Plants grow at the tips of roots and shoots by apical meristem, which makes them longer.

beats.en: Plants grow at the tips of roots and shoots by apical meristem, which makes them longer.
beats.speakEn: Plants grow at the tips of roots and shoots by apical meristem, which makes them longer.

beats.en: Lateral meristem makes plants grow in girth, becoming thicker, and intercalary meristem helps grass grow again after grazing.
beats.speakEn: Lateral meristem makes plants grow in girth, becoming thicker, and intercalary meristem helps grass grow again after grazing.
